news.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam Trailer Locks Release Date Ahead of October Theatrical Premiere
news.summary: Makers of the upcoming family drama Aadarsha Kutumbam are reportedly gearing up to unveil the theatrical trailer on October 4, 2026. Starring Venkatesh and directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the movie is slated to hit screens on October 9, 2026.
body: The collaborative project bringing together actor Venkatesh and director Trivikram Srinivas, titled Aadarsha Kutumbam, is building significant pre-release momentum. Industry buzz indicates that the creative team will launch the official theatrical trailer on October 4, 2026, just days ahead of the film's scheduled arrival on the big screen.

Positioned as a family drama, the project features Srinidhi Shetty as the female lead. The ensemble cast also includes Nivetha Pethuraj, Nara Rohith, Pujita Ponnada, Rao Ramesh, Yuvina Parthavi, and Satya in key supporting roles.

Produced under the Haarika & Hassine Creations banner, the movie features a musical score composed by Thaman. With a theatrical release date locked for October 9, 2026, the forthcoming trailer launch is expected to amplify audience anticipation for the actor-director duo's latest venture.

news.title: Kajal Aggarwal's The India Story Lands on OTT in Telugu and Tamil
news.summary: The Kajal Aggarwal-starrer The India Story has expanded its streaming footprint by arriving in Telugu and Tamil on JioHotstar. While the film previously had a Hindi theatrical release, its regional language versions bypassed cinemas and are now available digitally.
body: The India Story, starring Kajal Aggarwal in the lead role, is now accessible to viewers in Telugu and Tamil languages on the JioHotstar streaming platform. Although the production team initially planned a multilingual theatrical rollout, only the Hindi version secured a theatrical run, which had a limited box office impact.

Following its earlier digital premiere in Hindi, the platform has now added the Telugu and Tamil tracks. This digital expansion offers the project a fresh opportunity to connect with regional audiences who missed out on a theatrical viewing experience.

Directed by Chettan DK, the film features Shreyas Talpade alongside Kajal Aggarwal, supported by a cast including Manish Wadhwa, Murli Sharma, Atul Tiwari, and Kamlesh Sawant. The project was produced by Sagar B Shinde with a soundtrack composed by Mangesh Dhakde.

news.title: Mani Ratnam's Geethanjali 4K Re-Release Pushed to November
news.summary: The 4K restored version of Mani Ratnam's classic romantic drama Geethanjali has locked a new theatrical release date of November 13, 2026. The re-release was previously delayed from August to allow for extensive picture and sound restoration work.
body: The 1989 classic Geethanjali, starring Nagarjuna and Girija Shettar, is officially returning to the big screen in an enhanced 4K format on November 13, 2026. The romantic drama was initially scheduled for an August 28 release to coincide with Nagarjuna's birthday, but the team postponed the rollout to complete additional restoration work aimed at achieving high picture and sound quality.

Directed by Mani Ratnam, Geethanjali remains notable as his sole direct Telugu feature film. The narrative follows two terminally ill individuals discovering love and embracing life despite their limited time, celebrated for its poetic storytelling and unconventional approach to romance and mortality.

The technical framework of the original film features PC Sreeram's cinematography capturing Ooty's landscapes alongside Ilaiyaraaja's score. The contemporary theatrical re-release seeks to present these elements through updated digital restoration technology for both nostalgic viewers and new audiences.

news.title: NTR Praises Fahadh Faasil Starrer 'Dont Trouble The Trouble'
news.summary: Actor NTR has shared high praise for the upcoming film Dont Trouble The Trouble, starring Fahadh Faasil and directed by Shashank Yeleti. Calling it an emotional roller coaster suitable for families, NTR lauded the performances and music ahead of its release.
body: Ahead of the theatrical release of Dont Trouble The Trouble on October 2, 2026, prominent figures from the industry have continued to voice their support. Following reviews from Mahesh Babu, Young Tiger NTR has now shared his appreciation for the project starring Fahadh Faasil.

NTR commended debut director Shashank Yeleti for highlighting core emotions effectively in his maiden feature. He also singled out child artist Sara for her performance, alongside praising Kaala Bhairava's background music for elevating the film's tone.

Describing the movie as an emotional journey spanning from the police station sequence to the climax, NTR noted that it serves as a watchable family entertainer. He expressed pride in producer Karthikeya's backing of the venture and encouraged audiences to experience it in theatres.

news.title: Saif Ali Khan and Priyanka Chopra to Share Screen in Ritesh Batra's International Project
news.summary: Bollywood stars Saif Ali Khan and Priyanka Chopra are reportedly teaming up for the first time in an upcoming international film directed by acclaimed filmmaker Ritesh Batra. The project has sparked significant curiosity among fans, uniting two prominent actors known for their distinct cinematic journeys.
body: Bollywood is gearing up for a fresh on-screen pairing as Saif Ali Khan and Priyanka Chopra are reportedly set to star together in an upcoming international film. Directed by acclaimed filmmaker Ritesh Batra, the project marks the very first time the two prominent actors will share screen space in lead roles.

While both performers have enjoyed extensive and successful careers in the Indian film industry, their paths have never crossed on-screen until now. Ritesh Batra, widely recognized for helming critically acclaimed features like The Lunchbox and Photograph, is developing this venture as a major international outing.

Pyanka Chopra has continued to expand her global presence through international television and film projects such as Citadel and Heads of State, alongside working on her comeback Indian feature Varanasi. Meanwhile, Saif Ali Khan continues to balance mainstream commercial projects and content-driven scripts, though his recent outing in Priyadarshan's Haiwaan faced a disappointing box-office run.
The newly announced collaboration has generated considerable interest across trade circles and among fans eager to see what kind of narrative Batra will craft for the unusual lead pairing.

news.title: Sandeep Reddy Vanga-Backed Romanchakam Makes Its OTT Debut on Netflix
news.summary: The romantic or content-driven drama Romanchakam, backed by filmmaker Sandeep Reddy Vanga and produced by Pranav Reddy Vanga, has officially landed on Netflix in multiple languages. After failing to draw expected theatrical crowds, the Sumanth Ashwin and Ananthika Sanilkumar starrer seeks a fresh lease of life on streaming.
body: Romanchakam, a film heavily promoted and backed by prominent filmmaker Sandeep Reddy Vanga, has officially arrived on Netflix. Following its theatrical run, the movie is now streaming in multiple languages for digital audiences.

Produced by Pranav Reddy Vanga under the banner Bhadrakali Pictures, the project features Sumanth Ashwin and Ananthika Sanilkumar in the lead roles. Despite extensive pre-release promotional pushes by Sandeep Reddy Vanga, the movie failed to capture strong traction among young audiences during its time in cinema halls.

The transition to OTT offers the feature a secondary platform to connect with a wider viewer base. Alongside the lead pair, the supporting cast includes Narendra Ravi, Venkatesh Kakumanu, Mani Aegurla, Sai Sohan, and Upendra Limaye, with a musical score composed by Vasuki Vaibhav.
Industry watchers will be closely observing how the title performs on streaming after its underwhelming theatrical box office outcome.

news.title: Historic Distribution Banner Mayuri Film Distributors Makes Theatrical Comeback
news.summary: Mayuri Film Distributors, a notable banner under the Ramoji Group, is returning to theatrical distribution after a long hiatus. The company is backing the content-driven film Thella Kaagitham, which receives a wide release in Krishna district alongside worldwide premieres.
body: Mayuri Film Distributors, historically recognized as a major distribution arm under the Ramoji Group, is making a prominent return to the theatrical market after an extended break. The company has opted for a content-focused film, Thella Kaagitham, to spearhead its comeback campaign.

During its peak operational years in the 1990s, Mayuri established a corporate and systematic approach to movie distribution. The enterprise revolutionized regional trade practices by carefully analyzing content, identifying specific target audiences, studying local viewing preferences, and operating an extensive network of 19 regional offices across Andhra Pradesh.

The upcoming release of Thella Kaagitham marks a shift away from conventional star-driven vehicles toward content-led cinema. The project is slated for a worldwide release, backed by paid premieres and advance bookings initiated in the Krishna district.
The return of such a legacy distribution house has successfully generated strong trade curiosity as the distribution team commences its promotional rollout.

news.title: Karthi's Spy Thriller Sardar 2 Arrives on Amazon Prime Video Three Weeks Post-Release
news.summary: Karthi's spy action thriller Sardar 2 has transitioned to Amazon Prime Video just three weeks after its theatrical debut. Directed by PS Mithran, the Tamil film seeks a second chance at finding an audience on streaming following a disappointing box-office run.
body: Following a brief and underperforming theatrical stint, Karthi's spy action thriller Sardar 2 has officially made its way to digital platforms. The Tamil feature has arrived on Amazon Prime Video in multiple languages, including Telugu, merely three weeks after its initial big-screen premiere.

Released initially amid high expectations, the sequel failed to resonate strongly with audiences at the box office, wrapping up its theatrical run on a disappointing note. The swift OTT release grants the action drama a second window to capture viewer interest and potentially achieve a stronger reception on home screens.
Directed by filmmaker PS Mithran, Sardar 2 stars Karthi in dual roles. The extensive cast also features SJ Suryah, Malavika Mohanan, Ashika Ranganath, and Rajisha Vijayan in key roles.
The film was bankrolled by producers S Lakshman Kumar and Ishan Saksena under the banners of Prince Pictures and IVY Entertainment, with music handled by composer Sam CS.

news.title: Breakout Performances: How 'The Paradise' Shined Spotlight on Kranthi Balivada and Vishika
news.summary: While Sampoornesh Babu took on a standard role in the big-scale venture The Paradise, actors Kranthi Balivada and Vishika managed to capture audience attention. Kranthi gained social media recognition for her memorable dubbing work and a standout dialogue, while Vishika impressed viewers with her strong performance in the second half.
body: When Sampoornesh Babu signed on for The Paradise, the actor chose to focus exclusively on the high-profile project, dropping other offers in anticipation of a career-boosting role. Known for breaking out with Hrudaya Kaleyam, Sampoornesh played a character named Biryani. Despite pre-release hype surrounding the part, the actual screen time featured a routine, regular role that offered limited scope to display his acting capabilities.

Instead, the film unexpectedly propelled other artists into the spotlight. Kranthi Balivada, who portrayed Kayadu Lohar's mother on screen, drew considerable praise across social media channels. Aside from her acting duties, Kranthi is an accomplished dubbing artist who lent her voice to actress Sonali Kulkarni—playing Nani's mother Sammakka—and has previously worked on major projects including the KGF franchise. Her prominent dialogue in the teaser praising Kayadu as a single-take artist became a viral talking point.

Another name making waves from the project is young actor Vishika. Having built a resume with previous appearances in films like Court, Korean Kanakaraju, Patang, and Committee Kurrollu, Vishika captured widespread appreciation for her work during the movie's second half, positioning herself well for future opportunities in major productions.

For Sampoornesh Babu, the experience serves as a reminder to re-evaluate his selection process for future films. While being part of a large-scale enterprise added a notable title to his filmography, it ultimately functioned as a standard project rather than a definitive turning point for his career.

news.title: Producer Dinesh Vijan Confirms 'Stree 3' Release Plans for Late 2028
news.summary: Producer Dinesh Vijan has revealed that the third installment of the popular horror-comedy franchise Stree will go on floors at the end of next year. Speaking at FICCI Frames 2026, Vijan shared that director Amar Kaushik has completed the script, with theatrical arrivals slated for late 2028.
body: Producer Dinesh Vijan and actor Rajkummar Rao provided fresh details regarding the future of the horror-comedy universe while attending FICCI Frames 2026 to promote their upcoming feature, Prahaar. During the event, Vijan outlined the timeline for the highly anticipated Stree franchise continuation.

According to Vijan, director Amar Kaushik remains central to the horror-comedy slate. Kaushik is scheduled to direct the ambitious film Mahavatar, focusing on the story of Bhagwan Parshuram, beginning in late January and wrapping up by June. Following that commitment, the team will commence production on Stree 3 by the end of next year.

Addressing the creative direction of the upcoming threequel, Vijan noted that the narrative will offer a complete revelation in terms of its starting and ending points, promising fans an unexpected trajectory while retaining core elements of the franchise. The production house is currently eyeing a theatrical release in 2028, potentially coinciding with a major holiday window such as Independence Day or Christmas.

news.title: Ajay Devgn's 'Drishyam 3' Set to Deliver Final Chapter as Hindi Franchise Concludes
news.summary: Following mixed reactions to the Malayalam conclusion of the Drishyam franchise, all attention shifts to Ajay Devgn's Hindi adaptation arriving on October 2, 2026. The makers have officially confirmed that this installment will serve as the final chapter, placing pressure on the team to deliver a satisfying emotional closure.
body: The Drishyam series stands as one of the most prominent thriller franchises in contemporary Indian cinema. While the Malayalam iteration anchored by Mohanlal pioneered the narrative arc, its third installment drew mixed responses from viewers despite registering strong box office numbers in Kerala, with sections of the audience feeling the story left doors open rather than offering definitive closure to Georgekutty's saga.

Attention now pivots entirely toward the Hindi version starring Ajay Devgn, scheduled for release on October 2, 2026. Producers have officially stated that this third entry will mark the absolute conclusion of the franchise in Hindi, elevating anticipation among fans seeking a concrete resolution.

The core obstacle for the creative team lies in crafting a convincing and emotionally fulfilling finale after years of investment from viewers. Successfully navigating this concluding chapter could cement the franchise's legacy while capitalizing on positive initial booking trends at the box office.

news.title: The Dangers of Premiere Night Negativity and Ticket Hikes in Modern Cinema
news.summary: The rapid spread of negative reactions during film premieres has turned opening weekends into high-stress windows for filmmakers. With social media algorithms rewarding critical takes and ticket price hikes lowering audience patience, producers face intense scrutiny that can jeopardize a movie's initial run.
body: Recent high-profile releases have highlighted a growing trend of intense negativity surrounding premiere shows, leaving filmmakers visibly stunned by the immediate backlash. Unlike past decades, when rival fanbases clashed while general audiences still gave films a fair chance, contemporary social media dynamics have eliminated much of that breathing space.

Platforms like X and Instagram now encourage swift, critical commentary as accounts chase high engagement and reach. Similarly, digital reviewers often find that tearing down a film generates more views than balanced analysis. This environment creates high-pressure opening weekends, causing production teams to hesitate before even checking social media during a movie's initial days.

However, industry observers note that digital platforms alone are not entirely to blame. The issue is frequently magnified when studios host paid premieres alongside increased ticket pricing. When viewers pay extra to attend early screenings, they often enter the auditorium with elevated expectations and reduced tolerance for flaws. Any minor narrative misstep is quickly amplified, turning routine criticism into a widespread negative wave that can severely impact a film's theatrical trajectory.

news.title: A Packed October 2nd Weekend Brings Diverse Pan-Indian and Global Titles to Theaters
news.summary: Movie enthusiasts face a crowded box office this weekend as October 2nd brings a wide array of multi-language releases, headlined by Fahadh Faasil's straight Telugu film, Sandeep Kishan's Sigma, and various other regional and Hollywood offerings.
body: The upcoming holiday weekend starting October 2, 2026, presents a crowded lineup of theatrical offerings spanning multiple languages and genres. With the date falling on a Friday national holiday, cinephiles have access to a diverse mix of cinematic choices at the ticket windows.

Among the prominent regional arrivals is Fahadh Faasil's straight Telugu feature, 'Dont Trouble The Trouble', which showcases the actor in a full-length lead role and marks the directorial debut of Sashank Yeleti. Another notable Telugu release carrying considerable pre-release interest is 'Sigma', starring Sundeep Kishan and directed by Jason Sanjay, son of Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay. Meanwhile, Nivin Pauly ventures into a dual-language release with 'Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai' in Tamil and 'Sanchari' in Telugu, directed by Ram and featuring Soori and Anjali.

Additional South Indian titles arriving on the same day include Vijay Sethupathi's 1986 Madras gangster comedy-drama 'Baththa', helmed by Balaji Tharaneetharan, and the Shivarajkumar-starrer action drama 'Bail', directed by Pavan Wadeyar and co-starring Deekshith Shetty.

On the Hindi front, Ajay Devgn returns with the theatrical release of 'Drishyam 3', featuring a stellar supporting cast including Shriya Saran, Rajat Kapoor, Jaideep Ahlawat, and Prakash Raj. Bollywood also sees the release of the official 'Premalu' remake directed by Apoorv Singh Karki, starring Veer Pahariya and debutante Aafiya Sayed. International releases rounding out the holiday frame include the Tom Cruise dark comedy 'Digger' and Anne Hathaway's psychological erotic thriller 'Verity'.

news.title: Superstar Mahesh Babu Shares Glowing Review of Fahadh Faasil's 'Dont Trouble The Trouble'
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu has praised the upcoming film 'Dont Trouble The Trouble' following a private screening, lauding Fahadh Faasil's performance and director Shashank Yeleti's world-building in a detailed social media review.
body: Ahead of its theatrical release on October 2, 2026, superstar Mahesh Babu took to social media to share his thoughts on 'Dont Trouble The Trouble' after attending a private screening. The actor offered high praise for the project, describing it as a complete, happy, and well-crafted cinematic experience.

Mahesh highlighted the film's rare emotional warmth, noting that it manages to be both deeply moving and thoroughly entertaining. He reserved special appreciation for Malayalam actor Fahadh Faasil, commending his dedication to experimentation and character reinvention, while also praising the on-screen chemistry between Fahadh and young co-star Ssara Palekar.

Furthermore, the superstar congratulated director Shashank Yeleti for establishing a unique world within the narrative. He also acknowledged producers SS Karthikeya and Shobu Yarlagadda, noting that the team has a gem on their hands.

The early endorsement carries significant weight given Mahesh Babu's standing among moviegoers. As the film is presented by SS Rajamouli's family—with whom Mahesh is currently collaborating on the upcoming feature 'Varanasi'—the glowing critique has amplified pre-release anticipation for the project.

news.title: Shiva Kandukuri's 'Talcum Powder' Unveils Hilarious First Glimpse
news.summary: The makers of Shiva Kandukuri's upcoming film 'Talcum Powder' have released a humorous first glimpse introducing a drug peddler named Bunty, setting up a chaotic chase involving cops and the mafia ahead of its November release.
body: The creative team behind Shiva Kandukuri's upcoming film, 'Talcum Powder', has released its official glimpse, offering audiences a humorous preview of the narrative. Directed by Sainath Ponna, the movie is being presented by Raj Kandukuri, renowned for backing critically acclaimed projects like 'Pellichoopulu'.

The newly released video snippet introduces a key character, a drug peddler named Bunty, and establishes a chaotic premise involving both law enforcement and the drug mafia pursuing him. The promotional clip features appearances by Venkatesh Maha, A. Jeevan Kumar, and presenter Raj Kandukuri, generating positive traction among movie enthusiasts.

Drishika Chander stars as the female lead alongside Shiva Kandukuri. The film's technical crew includes Osho V as the music director, with GV Ajay Kumar managing cinematography and Surya Ponnapalli handling editing.
Following the positive reception of the initial glimpse, 'Talcum Powder' is slated for a grand theatrical release on November 13, 2026.

news.title: Telugu Release of Nivin Pauly and Soori's Sanchari Postponed Due to Title Issue
news.summary: The Telugu version of the upcoming film starring Nivin Pauly and Soori, titled Sanchari, has been postponed from its scheduled release date. Directed by Ram, the movie's makers announced that the delay stems from a title issue. A fresh release date is expected to be announced shortly.
body: The theatrical release of Sanchari, the Telugu version of the Tamil film originally titled 112 Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai, has hit a temporary roadblock. Directed by filmmaker Ram, the project features Nivin Pauly and Kollywood actor Soori in crucial roles, alongside actress Anjali. The production team initially planned to launch the Telugu version simultaneously with the Tamil original.

According to the latest updates, the release has been put on hold due to ongoing title issues. Consequently, the planned simultaneous premiere did not take place. Producers Suresh Kamatchi and V House Productions have confirmed that a new arrival date will be revealed to audiences soon.

The project marks an important outing for Nivin Pauly following his recent successes. The film's music has been composed by Yuvan Shankar Raja, building significant anticipation among fans across industries ahead of its eventual rollout.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Crosses ₹150 Crore Worldwide as Makers Look to Extended Weekend
news.summary: Nani's latest starrer, The Paradise, has surpassed ₹150 crore in worldwide gross collections after completing its first week in theatres. While Nizam remains a strong territory, the film faces slow collections in parts of Andhra Pradesh, prompting star Nani to undertake promotional tours. The makers are now eyeing a boost from the upcoming long weekend and holiday advantages.
body: Nani's action drama The Paradise has wrapped up its first week at the box office, crossing the ₹150 crore gross mark globally. The feature opened to record-breaking figures, marking a career-high opening milestone for the lead actor. However, box-office momentum has tapered off in specific sectors, particularly across various territories in Andhra Pradesh following the initial weekend rush.

Amidst the slowing collections, Nizam has emerged as the most resilient market for the film, recently achieving break-even status inclusive of GST. To support the theatrical run and encourage footfalls, Nani has actively stepped up promotional efforts, undertaking a tour across Andhra Pradesh to engage directly with audiences. Trade circles have taken note of the actor's sustained commitment to the project post-release.

Looking ahead, the production team is banking heavily on an extended second weekend to bolster ticket sales. With Gandhi Jayanti falling on Friday, the extra holiday advantage offers a crucial window for recovery. Even with incoming theatrical competition from new releases like Simga and Don't Trouble The Trouble, this holiday period could help The Paradise bridge its remaining financial gaps in regional markets.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Stuns on Filmfare Cover as She Gears Up for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?
news.summary: Actress Taapsee Pannu has captured attention with her latest high-fashion appearance on the Filmfare cover, showcasing multiple striking looks. On the cinematic front, the actress is currently shooting for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan? where she portrays ACP Komal Sharma. Despite a challenging box-office run in 2026, she maintains strong momentum in her career.
body: Taapsee Pannu continues to make waves in fashion spaces, most recently featuring on the latest cover of Filmfare. The actress showcased a versatile array of outfits, ranging from a sky-blue sequin mini dress accented by a golden potli to a printed teal co-ord set, a shimmering gold gown, a royal blue slit dress, and a bubble-hem white bandeau ensemble.

While her editorial appearances continue to draw praise, the year 2026 has presented theatrical hurdles for the performer. Her previous big-screen outings, Advocate Raavi and Gandhari, underperformed at the box office, failing to leave a major financial mark in cinemas.

Undeterred by the setbacks, Pannu remains active on production sets. She is currently filming Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?, stepping into the role of ACP Komal Sharma. Fans and industry watchers are closely tracking the project, anticipating a strong silver-screen comeback from the actress.

news.title: Akshay Kumar and Priyadarshan's Crime Thriller Haiwaan Fails to Impress at the Box Office
news.summary: The crime thriller Haiwaan, starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan under Priyadarshan's direction, has emerged as a major box office disappointment. After an underwhelming opening and weekend, the official remake finished its lifetime run under the Rs. 10 crore mark.
body: The theatrical run of the crime thriller Haiwaan has concluded as one of the most severe underperformances in recent Indian cinema. Headlined by top star Akshay Kumar alongside Saif Ali Khan and directed by Priyadarshan, the project struggled to connect with moviegoers right from its debut.

The film managed an opening day collection of just over Rs. 2.5 crore nett, followed by a modest first weekend total of Rs. 6.7 crore nett. Following the weekend, ticket sales dropped significantly, bringing the overall lifetime earnings to a disappointing Rs. 9 crore nett.

Industry observers noted that pre-release traction was hampered by negative discussions surrounding its status as an official remake of the Malayalam feature Oppam, which released a decade prior. Coupled with a weak word-of-mouth response from audiences, the film failed to sustain any momentum at the box office.

news.title: Ravi Teja's Irumudi Claims Global Top Spot on Netflix Following Strong Theatrical Run
news.summary: Mass Maharaja Ravi Teja's Irumudi has secured the global number-one position among non-English films on Netflix. Following a profitable theatrical run, the movie has registered over 6.8 million views on the streaming platform.
body: Irumudi, starring Mass Maharaja Ravi Teja and directed by Shiva Nirvana, is continuing its successful streak on digital platforms after a strong theatrical exhibition. Produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the project previously achieved robust box office collections, benefiting producers, distributors, and exhibitors alike.

After concluding its run in theaters, the film made its streaming debut on Netflix on the 18th of the month. It quickly climbed the charts to secure the global number-one spot among non-English language titles.

The project has accumulated over 6.8 million in viewership on the platform to date. This cross-platform performance highlights a rare instance where a feature succeeds commercially in cinemas while drawing substantial digital engagement worldwide.

news.title: Shiva Kandukuri's Talcum Powder Drops First Glimpse Highlighting Crime and Comedy
news.summary: National Award-winning producer Raj Kandukuri is backing the upcoming crime dramedy Talcum Powder, directed by Sainath Ponna. Starring Shiva Kandukuri as a drug peddler named Bunty, the movie has released its introductory glimpse ahead of a November theatrical release.
body: Filmmakers behind Talcum Powder have officially launched the project's promotional campaign with an introductory glimpse titled The First Sprinkle. The new-age crime dramedy is presented by National Award-winning producer Raj Kandukuri under the Dharmapatha Creations banner.

Written and directed by Sainath Ponna, the movie features Shiva Kandukuri in the lead role alongside female lead Drishika Chander. The narrative centers on a drug peddler named Bunty who encounters unexpected trouble after a misstep, leading to a frantic chase involving both the police and local goons.

The promotional video offers a look into the film's quirky and unpredictable tone, combining crime elements with comedy. The cast also features performances by Venkatesh Maha and A Jeevan Kumar, with cinematography by GV Ajay Kumar, music by Osho V, and editing by Surya Ponnapalli. The film is scheduled to hit theaters on November 13.

news.title: Mahesh Babu Praises Fahadh Faasil Starrer Don't Trouble The Trouble After Special Screening
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu has shared high praise for Fahadh Faasil's upcoming Telugu film Don't Trouble The Trouble directed by Shashank Yeleti. Following a special screening, the actor commended the team on social media for delivering a warm and entertaining cinematic experience.
body: Fahadh Faasil's upcoming straight Telugu movie Don't Trouble The Trouble has garnered early endorsement from Superstar Mahesh Babu following a private screening. Directed by debutant Shashank Yeleti, the project is backed by producers Shobu Yarlagadda, Prasad Devineni, and S.S. Karthikeya under Arka Media Works and Showing Business, with S.S. Rajamouli presenting.

Taking to social media, Mahesh Babu described the film as a well-crafted, happy, and complete experience. He highlighted that the project successfully balances thorough entertainment with deep emotional resonance while maintaining a consistent sense of warmth.

The actor also lauded the central performances, noting the strong chemistry between Fahadh Faasil and Ssara, and congratulated S.S. Karthikeya on his maiden production venture. The film is scheduled for release on October 2.

news.title: Chandoo Mondeti Confirms Bilingual Project with Rana Daggubati and Akshay Kumar
news.summary: Director Chandoo Mondeti has addressed recent speculation, confirming that he is teaming up with Rana Daggubati and Akshay Kumar for a Hindi-Telugu bilingual titled Mahakaal. The filmmaker clarified that while the project is moving forward, it remains in the early pre-production stages with no involvement from Sanjay Leela Bhansali.
body: Filmmaker Chandoo Mondeti has broken his silence regarding swirling industry rumors about his upcoming directorial venture. Confirming part of the speculation, the National Award-winning director announced that he is indeed collaborating with Rana Daggubati and Bollywood star Akshay Kumar for a multi-language project tentatively titled Mahakaal.

Providing clarity on the production front, Mondeti shared that Karan Johar is slated to produce the Hindi version of the film through arrangements made by Rana. Meanwhile, discussions for the Telugu version's banner are ongoing as the team searches for a major production house. The director emphasized that the project is currently in its initial phase, with focus centered on story discussions, finalizing technicians, and kicking off pre-production.

Addressing separate rumors linking Bollywood filmmaker Sanjay Leela Bhansali to the film as a writer, Mondeti firmly dismissed the connection. He stated that the story and direction belong entirely to him, though he noted that he is in separate talks with Bhansali for an unrelated future story.

Mondeti revealed that the collaboration took shape after multiple meetings in Mumbai with Rana Daggubati, where several pitches eventually led to the selection of this mythological subject. Although set against the backdrop of Ujjain and tied to a larger-than-life historical narrative, the director noted that picking a mythological theme was not a calculated franchise move, but rather a creative calling inspired by local history.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna Unveil Historical Context Behind Ranabaali
news.summary: The team behind Ranabaali has released the second installment of their promotional documentary series, featuring insights from lead actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna. The film, directed by Rahul Sankrityan, explores historical perspectives on British colonial exploitation and is scheduled to release on October 16.
body: As anticipation builds for the release of Ranabaali, the film's team has utilized a four-episode documentary-style series to give audiences a deeper look into the project's historical backdrop. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the feature explores the severe impacts of colonial rule in the Madras Presidency.

In the newly unveiled second episode, lead actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna discussed lesser-known historical realities addressed in the film. They highlighted how the British railway system was originally established primarily to accelerate the transport of Indian grains, spices, cotton, and gold to ports rather than to improve local infrastructure.

Deverakonda remarked that because colonial authorities authored the historical accounts, key details regarding these systemic extraction methods were omitted from standard educational syllabi. Echoing these sentiments, Mandanna shared that uncovering these in-depth historical truths provided a profound realization during the project's making.
Ranabaali is set to hit the big screen on October 16, positioning itself as a narrative-driven cinematic exploration of a man-made famine caused by colonial grain appropriation.

news.title: Maadhav's Debut Film Maremma Locks OTT Release Date Across Two Major Platforms
news.summary: Maremma, the rural drama marking the acting debut of Maadhav Bhupathiraju, has set its digital premiere. The film will stream simultaneously on Aha and Amazon Prime Video starting October 9, 2026, following its earlier theatrical release in September.
body: Maadhav Bhupathiraju, nephew of Tollywood star Ravi Teja, made his entry into the film industry with the theatrical release of Maremma on September 10, 2026. The rural drama is now expanding its reach to audiences through a digital streaming debut.

Streaming platforms Aha and Amazon Prime Video have secured the digital rights for the movie. According to the latest schedule, Maremma is set to premiere on both platforms on October 9, 2026, with an official announcement anticipated shortly.

Directed by Manchala Nagaraj and produced by Mayur Reddy Bandaru, the rural drama features an ensemble cast including Deepa Balu, Vikas Vasishta, Vinod Kumar, V.S. Rupa Lakshmi, and Dayanand Reddy. The film's musical score was composed by Prashanth R. Vihari and Bipradeep Dutta.

news.title: Prabhas and Hanu Raghavapudi's 'Fauji' Delayed Indefinitely Amid Extended Shoot Schedule
news.summary: The makers of Prabhas and Hanu Raghavapudi's upcoming film Fauji have postponed its December 3 release date indefinitely. Production is still ongoing, with Prabhas requiring over 60 working days to wrap up his remaining portions.
body: The anticipated Telugu project Fauji, starring Prabhas and directed by Hanu Raghavapudi, has faced multiple setbacks with its latest scheduled release date of December 3 now pushed back indefinitely. Production on the film is still underway, and insiders reveal that a substantial portion of the shoot remains incomplete.

According to production sources, lead actor Prabhas still needs to dedicate more than 60 working days to finish his sequences. Given his concurrent commitments to director Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s Spirit, completing these required shooting days is expected to take another four months, leaving the team without a clear timeline for overall completion.

Because of the ongoing delays, the production house is reportedly in no hurry to lock in a new theatrical premiere date. While Prabhas's upcoming birthday on October 23 is expected to bring new promotional content or a fresh poster, the makers will likely avoid announcing a release schedule at that time.

The high-profile period drama also marks the acting debut of Imanvi, who stars as the female lead alongside Prabhas. Trade watchers and fans will have to wait for official updates from the makers once the remaining shooting schedule is firmly mapped out.

news.title: Karthi's Quick OTT Premieres Spark Trade Debate Over Shrinking Theatrical Windows
news.summary: Actor Karthi's recent films are transitioning to streaming platforms within two to three weeks of their theatrical release. Trade analysts are expressing concern that rapid digital debuts for underperforming films could negatively impact box-office footfalls.
body: Tamil actor Karthi's spy thriller sequel Sardar 2 has arrived on Amazon Prime Video just 21 days after its theatrical debut, marking a significantly shortened exclusive cinema window. This rapid transition to streaming follows a weak commercial run at the box office, continuing a pattern observed earlier in the year.

Earlier this year, Karthi's Pongal festive release, the comedy-action film Vaa Vaathiyar, hit the same streaming platform in five languages just 14 days after its January 28 theatrical opening. Both films faced subdued audience turnout in theatres, prompting producers to fast-track digital distribution.

Typically, major cinematic releases feature a theatrical exclusivity window of four to eight weeks, giving distributors and exhibitors sufficient time to recoup financial investments. However, the shift toward a two-to-three-week streaming window for underperforming titles has drawn scrutiny from industry analysts.

Exhibitors and trade experts worry that shortened windows alter audience viewing habits, potentially encouraging moviegoers to skip theatres entirely if they expect home viewing options within a fortnight. This trend raises questions about the long-term sustainability of box-office recovery for mainstream star-driven projects.
